items.question: What HR services does Workora provide?
items.answer: Workora provides talent acquisition, executive search, training and development, HR consulting, staffing solutions, career guidance, HR outsourcing, and recruitment process outsourcing.

items.question: Can you help with a specific role or hiring need?
items.answer: Yes. Share the role, skills, experience level, and timing you have in mind through our quote form. Our team will review your requirements and discuss a suitable approach.

items.question: How do you approach executive search?
items.answer: We start by understanding your organization and leadership needs, then identify and assess candidates for their experience and fit with your goals and culture.

items.question: Can Workora help me with career guidance?
items.answer: Our career guidance service offers personalized support to help professionals plan their development and work toward their career goals. Contact our team to discuss what support you need.

items.question: How can I discuss a career opportunity with your team?
items.answer: Use the Contact Us page to share your background and the type of opportunity you are exploring. Our team can point you toward the most relevant next step.

items.question: What should I include when I contact Workora?
items.answer: A short summary of your experience, the kind of role you are looking for, and your preferred location helps our team understand how to guide you.

items.question: How do I request a quote or consultation?
items.answer: Complete the Get a Quote form with your contact details and hiring requirements. You can also contact our team directly by phone or email.

items.question: What happens after I send an enquiry?
items.answer: Our team reviews the details you provide and follows up to understand your goals, requirements, and the best way to support your organization.

items.question: How long does it take to fill a role?
items.answer: Timing depends on the role, experience required, and hiring process. After discussing your requirements, our team can provide a more useful estimate for your search.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: The contact and quote forms on this website currently run in demo mode. Submitting either form does not send or save the information entered.

sections.heading: Information You Provide
paragraphs: The contact and quote forms currently run only in your browser. Submitting them does not transmit the entered name, email address, phone number, or message to Workora.
Please do not enter sensitive personal information into these demo forms.

sections.heading: How We Use Information
paragraphs: The current form implementation does not process submitted values. After submission, it only displays a confirmation page.
If these forms are connected to a submission service in the future, this policy should be updated before real enquiries are collected.

sections.heading: When Information Is Shared
paragraphs: Information entered in the current contact and quote forms is not transmitted to Workora or shared through those forms.
If you contact Workora directly by email or phone, your communication will be handled through those respective services.

sections.heading: Retention and Security
paragraphs: The current website code does not store values entered into the contact or quote forms. The form values are not persisted when you leave the page.
This statement describes the forms' current demo behavior and should be reviewed if the website begins collecting enquiries.

sections.heading: Your Choices and Contact
paragraphs: Because the current forms do not send or store their values, they do not create an enquiry record for Workora to access, correct, or delete.
For privacy questions, contact us at xyz@workora.com or call +1 (555) 234-8901.

sections.heading: Changes to This Policy
paragraphs: We may update this policy as our website or practices change. The latest revision date will be shown at the top of this page.
